notes:
### Added
- Read chapters aloud, with the voice generated on your own machine — no account, and no internet connection once the voice has downloaded
- The words light up as they are spoken and the rest of the chapter dims, so it is easy to follow along
- Audiobook export from the Publish page, as MP3 or WAV, with one track per chapter
- Narration voice and speed settings, with the voice downloaded on demand rather than bundled into the app
- OpenAI alongside Gemini for Muse, with an automatic switch to the other provider when one is unavailable
- Sidebars can be dragged to any width in Manuscript, Spark, Blueprint, Cast & World, Cartography and Genealogy
- Spark cards can be resized from any edge or corner
- Image and audio can be uploaded into Spark, and generated images can be downloaded
- Spark notes open in a full rich-text editor
- The Spark drawing editor gained shapes, selection, panning, zoom and a custom colour picker
- Tidy Up in Blueprint, to lay the board out again after editing
- The mobile app gained narration, audiobook export, the full drawing editor, card resizing, media upload and download, and the new settings layout

### Fixed
- The blinking cursor in the manuscript editor was taller than the text
- A Spark note reported "Updated a minute ago" the moment it was opened, before any edit
- The drawing tools sat underneath the zoom controls on phone-sized screens, which left Fill and Eraser impossible to tap
- The drawing canvas was not announced by screen readers
- Muse blamed a missing API key for problems that had nothing to do with keys, such as rate limits and provider outages, which sent you to re-enter a key that was already working
- Every Muse setting except creativity was lost when a project moved between mobile and desktop, including prompts you had written yourself
- The OpenAI key field asked you to paste a Google key
- Inactive Spark cards showed a blue outline, and their title sat too far from their content
- The drawing editor in the mobile app was missing the tools the desktop editor has

### Improved
- Sidebars follow the cursor while being resized instead of lagging behind it
- Blueprint now drafts a tighter outline of at most five beats rather than filling the board
- Colour swatches in the drawing editor meet contrast requirements against any background
- Chapters are narrated several sentences ahead in parallel, so playback does not stall between paragraphs
- Interface wording reviewed across all 23 languages

### Removed
- Expand Idea in Spark

### Changed
- Spark notes and drawings now open in their own editor rather than a small inline field
- The licence key description no longer mentions premium features, which this one-time purchase does not have

### Security
- Muse API keys now live in the operating system keychain, and in encrypted browser storage on mobile, instead of app settings; a key saved earlier is moved across on first launch
- API keys are no longer written into .novelos project archives, which are shared and backed up
